notes: Encoded ONLY from Hamilton's own page. Page covers Hamilton and Winchester brand systems; no system imported from any other page. Single style: all-digit serial, so character counting and numerical-digit counting coincide and there is no counting ambiguity.

styles.notes: Page positions (1-based): week = 8th & 9th numerical digits, year = 10th & 11th numerical digits, converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Normalized serial 010110126971000: week digits '26', year digits '97' -> 1997.
